verdict.rationale: Remote is a global payroll platform, so a payroll-preview-and-review story applies. The evidence only shows that payroll inputs can be pushed in and payroll data pulled out (remote-docs-2), plus payslip downloads in the CLI (remote-docs-20). There is no documented payroll preview endpoint, no anomaly surfacing, and no pre-approval review step for a payroll run, so pulling data is adjacent at best.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent run a payroll preview via the API and surface anomalies for review before I approve the run
